Entry contexts cover the root trigger, effect and weight blocks that a direct evaluator call, or a call through the block's own vtable, evaluates as a pointer to the owner's item plus the block's offset, where the method establishes that the pointer leads to the owner. Other virtual calls, nested blocks, script values and modifier blocks are outside this method.
